Market Drayton Town FC are delighted to announce the signings of Liam Prendergast, Archie Saunders and Miles Bradbury on dual registrations.

Liam and Archie join us from Brocton, while Miles makes the move from Hanley Town.

Liam is a Right Back who has been featuring regularly for Wyrley United this season. 

Archie is an energetic midfielder who has made 14 first-team appearances for Brocton this season.

Miles is a talented young midfielder who has broken into Hanleys first-team on a number of occasions this season. 

Manager Liam Kelly had the following to say:

“A massive thank you to Alex Curtis at Brocton and Scott Dundas at Hanley Town for their help in securing three extremely talented lads in Archie, Liam and Miles.”

“These boys have already made plenty of appearances at Steps 4 and 5 between them this season and, after just one training session, it’s clear they’ll be a great addition to what we’re trying to build here.

“I’m sure our supporters will give all three a warm welcome to the club.”

Everyone at Market Drayton Town FC warmly welcomes Liam, Archie and Miles and wishes them every success during their time with the club.
